card.name: "After" in contraception duration phrases
card.fires_on: The word "after" following a time span (e.g. "for 6 months") in advice on contraception after the last dose. Also fires weakly on "end" in "At the end of" a timed period.

modes.label: Contraception after last dose
modes.description: "after" comes right after a number of months or days, before "the last dose", in advice to females of reproductive potential.
modes.example: Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment and for 6 months<< after>> the last dose of ZEJULA

modes.label: End of a timed period
modes.description: "end" in "At the end of" a stated length of time in administration instructions.
modes.example: retain valrubicin intravesical solution in the bladder for two hours before voiding. At the<< end>> of two hours, all patients should void

card.writes: It likely favors "the last dose" style continuations and pushes away unrelated word completions; the promoted and suppressed tokens are otherwise uninformative.
card.plain: It marks the word "after" when a label says how long to keep using contraception after the last dose.
